scope: Final semantic and packaging review of the five already-read primary sources and their one completed saved-table audit; no new original LP, BI, RNG, or IC replay.
mathematical_review: For each fixed complete count table, sigma(h)=alpha(q(h)) assigns all ordered histories. The prescribed and deviating real continuations depend on counts, so all count-state ICs certify this particular full-history strategy; this is not a purification theorem.

Sparse decimal and denominator-limited masses define different exact rational inputs. Fractional IC violations remain disqualifying for that input; they cannot be removed by a numerical tolerance or transferred across inputs.
Current common-catalog model permits equal-coverage distinct labels. The original tables retain those labels and are valid candidates in that model without deleting aliases.
count_m5k6 trials4/97: cleared masses are one size5 block and five singleton blocks; OPT_5 is9 rather than total mass10, W=5 and target payoff1.
strong coefficient is4 rather than m=5; seven zero endpoints are the known size5-plus-four-singletons family. Finite fixed-point equality does not prove a general coefficient4 bound.
price trial0: two disjoint interest groups have masses5 and1. With total queries s,t on the groups, C-tau=5 min(1,s)+min(1,t)-s-t has exact maximum4; W=5 and target payoff1.
Seven-player file has95 saved trials although100 were requested. No output status or cause for the missing tail is inferred.
Negative local price proposals and negative saved LP objectives provide no exact global or fixed-cone upper bound; the report has no exact LP dual certificate.
